_comment: Rich per-city data for the programmatic city×course engine (gen-cross.mjs). Each city carries genuine local economy data so generated pages are meaningfully distinct, not name-swaps. Add cities here to scale.

cities.name: Bangalore
cities.anchor: India's technology and startup capital
cities.demand: AI and data roles are advertised faster here than anywhere else in India

cities.name: Hyderabad
cities.anchor: a hub of IT services, global pharma and fast-growing GCCs
industries: a world-leading pharma and life-sciences base
a booming global capability centre cluster
cities.demand: HITEC City firms and Genome Valley labs are hiring hard for applied AI

cities.name: Chennai
cities.anchor: the banking back-office and auto-manufacturing capital of India
industries: a vast auto and electronics manufacturing belt
cities.demand: BFSI processing and the SaaS belt both need people who can build with AI

cities.name: Pune
cities.anchor: a blend of IT services, an automotive belt and a huge student population
industries: one of India's largest student populations
cities.demand: Hinjewadi's IT firms and Chakan's plants are both leaning into automation

cities.name: Mumbai
cities.anchor: India's financial, media and advertising capital

cities.demand: BFSI, media and agencies are all racing to put AI to work
